title: Carly: shift detail sheet
question: One sheet for any shift: who, times, worked, photos, notes, flags. It opens from her Today card, her list, and the new records screen. Which order? Pick one, or steer.

options.label: A Facts first, then photos
options.lineage: Same hairline facts as the flag sheet Carly already uses
options.thesis: Clock-in, clock-out and worked time as facts, then a 3-across photo grid, then notes and flags.
options.viewport: Josh · Night shift · Wed 28 Oct; Clock-in 7:02 pm (At the gym); Clock-out 9:58 pm; Worked 2h 56m; Photos 8 of 10 grid; Notes.
options.risk: Photos start below the fold on a small phone; she scrolls once to see them all.

options.label: B Photos first
options.lineage: A photo review, with times as one line
options.thesis: One summary line for the times, then big 2-across photos, because checking the cleaning is why she opens it.
options.viewport: Josh · Night shift; 'In 7:02 pm · Out 9:58 pm · 2h 56m · At the gym'; six big photos; Notes.
options.risk: Location and correction details get pushed down, and flags are easy to miss.

options.label: C Tabs: Photos · Times · Notes
options.thesis: A short sheet with three tabs, so nothing scrolls far. Opens on Photos, or on Times when there is a flag.
options.viewport: Josh · Night shift; [Photos 8 | Times | Notes 1]; photo grid.
options.risk: Hides two of the three parts behind a tap; a flag or note can go unseen.
